## Free APIs (Web3 Tools Hub)
These tools are free to use without authentication:

### /api/tools/gas-tracker
Real-time gas prices across multiple chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC).
Input: ?chain=ethereum (optional)
Output: Standard, fast, instant gas prices with USD cost estimates

### /api/tools/allowance-checker
Check token allowances/approvals for any address.
Input: ?address=0x...&chain=ethereum
Output: All token approvals, spender info, risk assessment

### /api/tools/bridge-comparator
Compare bridge fees and times across protocols.
Input: ?token=USDC&amount=1000&source=ethereum&dest=base
Output: Quotes from multiple bridges, recommendations

### /api/articles/hackernoon
Fetch engineering articles from HackerNoon.
Output: Article titles, excerpts, dates

### /api/profile/linkedin
Fetch profile and experience data.
Output: Professional experience, skills

## Premium APIs (x402 Protocol)
These APIs require USDC payment via x402 protocol:

### /api/premium/bridge/quote ($0.01/request)
Advanced cross-chain bridge route optimization.
Input: amount, token, sourceChain, destChain
Output: Optimal routes with fees, timing, and execution paths

### /api/premium/defi/pool-analysis ($0.02/request)
DeFi liquidity pool deep analysis.
Input: protocol, poolAddress, token0, token1
Output: TVL, APY breakdown, risk score, IL calculation, recommendations
